title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 5.Highlights the need to finalise works on the revision of the Energy Taxation Directive4, which aims to align the taxation of energy products with the EU energy and climate policy objectives, and to harmonise a design of tariff methodologies for network charges, provided that such measures do not come at the expense of final consumers;calls on Member States to urgently provide short-term relief to industry and households, such as by reducing electricity taxes and levies; encourages the Member States to be ambitious and to inspire and creatively explore local and regional best practices in order to achieve quick and effective relief for local communities and industry; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1 Council Directive 2003/96/EC of 27 October 2003 restructuring the Community framework for the taxation of energy products and electricity (OJ L 283, 31.10.2003, p. 51, ELI: ).
